CommunityApplications.Profile: skgate is an MCP proxy with OAuth: paste a GitHub repo URL, a remote MCP server URL or an OpenAPI description and it builds, runs or wraps it and serves it behind one sign-in, so Grok, Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients can connect. It also proxies your SI providers behind one OpenAI-compatible address with model aliases, and your Grok subscription becomes that API with no API key. This repository maintains the skgate Docker container (a full image and a slim proxy-only image). Support: the Unraid forum thread and the GitHub issues.
